Pooled food web, not an island reef or nationally resolved EEZ model. Bibliographic/spatial correction:  Primary WCPFC landing lists downloadable SC3_EB_IP8.pdf. Primary 42-page 2007 report Section 2.2 explicitly states fixed 110–180 E,15 N–15 S; Section 2.3 states 31 final functional groups. Do not conflate with later 44-group 140–180 E/10 N–15 S warm-pool models. Report includes parameter, diet and catch tables; no native model file verified.
